method: One snapshot of the four product files taken once; each mutation an exact single-match replace that must change the file; the named suites run; every file restored from the snapshot and its sha256 checked against the intended content after each mutation and at the end (shasum -c: all OK). No git command inside the harness.

results.mutation: gap tie goes to the later pair
failing: × the earliest pair wins a tie; one date, or none, has no gap 30ms

failing: × equals what the life list implies over a generated corpus, escapees and all 13ms
× a timed checklist with no species under the rule is in the mean at zero; Statistics leaves it out 11ms
× sums usable kilometers: 0 counts, the bound is inclusive, and blank, negative, non-finite and over-bound cells are left out 27ms
× the bound is the decision's 2,400 kilometers, pinned by behaviour at the edge 4ms

× no countable species: no rate, no recorded once, no species rows; fewer than three dates: no gap; no usable distance: no row 18ms
